annotations.title: Dependency check: hygiene, plus live vulnerabilities

description: Check dependency manifests. Price: free by default; with live: true, 2 credits up to 50 packages, +1 per further 50, max 5 (200 packages). Default: offline hygiene lint for unpinned, wildcard or unbounded versions, missing lockfiles, git/URL deps, non-https indexes, install scripts, dependency-confusion names, plus a static snapshot of famous compromised versions. live: true adds, per package, known vulnerabilities from OSV.dev (exact versions only), latest version, licence and deprecation from deps.dev, and one verdict: PASS, REVIEW or FAIL (FAIL at fail_on severity or above, a denied licence, or a compromised version). Use this for manifests you can paste; use supply_chain_scan for a whole repo ZIP or MCP configs. Send exactly one of manifests (1-20 files) or upload_id + filename. Reads package.json, package-lock.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, Pipfile, go.mod, Gemfile, composer.json, pubspec.yaml. Nothing is installed or run. Bearer key required. Returns hygiene findings, a 0-100 score and grade A-F, and with live: true a live section with the verdict, per-package results and source attribution. Upstream outages are refunded (503 upstream_unavailable).

fail_on.description: Live mode only: the lowest advisory severity that makes the verdict FAIL. Lower-severity or unrated advisories give REVIEW.

filename.description: Required with upload_id, e.g. package.json: the file name decides how the content is parsed.

include_dev.description: Live mode only: also look up dev dependencies.

licence_policy.description: Live mode only: exactly one of allow or deny, a list of 1-100 SPDX licence ids. A package whose licence breaks the policy makes the verdict FAIL; an unknown licence gives REVIEW.

live.description: true adds live vulnerability, version, licence and deprecation lookups and a verdict, for 2-5 credits by package count. false (default) is the free offline hygiene check.

manifests.description: 1 to 20 manifest files inline, each up to 500,000 characters. Send exactly one of manifests or upload_id.

filename.description: File name, e.g. package.json; drives type detection.

upload_id.description: Instead of manifests: one manifest uploaded via the create_upload tool (your own uploads only). Send exactly one of manifests or upload_id.
